name: 11379 · Middle Vlg, NY
findings: ZIP 11379 (Middle Vlg) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11379 (Middle Vlg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
96% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
